recommended_phases.title: Phase 1: Shared types and audit-log foundation
recommended_phases.rationale: Zero upstream dependencies. shared-types defines enums and BaseEntity used by every module. audit-log provides the cross-cutting audit capability required by GP-002 for all state-changing operations.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2: Leave policy module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on shared-types. Provides policy validation rules that leave-request must consult before accepting submissions. Must exist before leave-request can enforce policy constraints.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3: Leave balance module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on shared-types and audit-log. Manages balance tracking that leave-request must query and mutate. Must exist before leave-request can deduct/restore balances.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4: Leave request module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on all prior phases. Orchestrates the full leave workflow: validates against policy, checks balances, submits/approves/rejects/cancels, and logs audit events. This is the integration module.

app_notes: Layer boundaries: shared-types (innermost, pure data shapes), audit-log (cross-cutting, GP-002), leave-policy (rules engine), leave-balance (state tracking), leave-request (orchestration, outermost). Dependencies flow strictly inward: leave-request → {leave-balance, leave-policy, audit-log, shared-types}; leave-balance → {audit-log, shared-types}; leave-policy → {shared-types}; audit-log → {shared-types}. No circular edges. All service interfaces declared before implementations. One open question on deduction timing (BR-001 pattern) recorded for design-agent resolution.

open_questions.question: When does balance deduction occur — on leave submission or on manager approval?
open_questions.impact: Affects both LeaveRequestService.submitLeaveRequest (whether it calls deductBalance immediately) and LeaveRequestService.cancelLeaveRequest (whether it calls restoreBalance). Also affects LeaveRequestService.rejectLeaveRequest (if deduction happened on submission, rejection must restore). The choice must be consistent across all three methods.
candidate_options: Deduct on submission, restore on rejection/cancellation
Deduct on approval only, no restore needed on rejection
